about_the_game:
It feels like just another ordinary day: the familiar room, the habitual conversations, and the gentle presence of your sister by your side.

Yet you find yourself unable to move forward—the unspoken shadow never lifts from your supposedly peaceful life.

If you pretend not to hear it, does it truly cease to exist?

And yet, everything is happening right before your eyes, undeniably real.

The words that should have been spoken… in the end, Nobody Hears.

“Nobody Hears” is a short multi-loop narrative game that blends exploration, puzzles, and environmental storytelling. Players will share a seemingly mundane daily life with their sister, uncovering subtle changes with each loop and slowly touching upon the truth hidden beneath routine.

 

Within the repetition, you will experience emotions of struggle, suppression, and release. Breaking the cycle is not only a puzzle to solve but also a confrontation with—and understanding of—yourself.

Through repeated exploration, you must notice and piece together the fine cracks in daily life, gradually assembling the deeper narrative beneath.

As new paths are unlocked, the true thoughts and unspoken words of the sisters will rise to the surface.

 

Will you accept the gentle illusion before you, or turn away after relentless struggle?

In the end, can you pierce the fog of memory and face the unavoidable truth?

The answer lies in every seemingly insignificant choice and action you take.

 ↓ ← → — Move with arrow keys

Z / Space / Enter — Interact

X / ESC — Menu

Shift — Run

May you find a happiness that is yours alone.

Believe it or not,

I too once wished for it with all my heart.

  • Multi-loop narrative structure: Fast and concise loop-based gameplay, where new branches and hidden clues emerge from the second loop onward.

  • Exploration and environmental puzzles: No text-based choices—only through observing and interacting with the environment can you break the cycle.

  • Five core storylines: Each arc includes multiple interaction paths, offering unique yet intentionally ambiguous choices.

  • Atmospheric storytelling: Narrative driven by detail and mood, with player interpretation and emotional resonance as part of the experience.

  • Compact and impactful: A tightly paced experience, perfect for players looking to feel emotional progression and reflection within a limited playtime.

 

Engine: RPG Maker MV

Development / Art / Design: MuGui_Cinnamon

Music / Sound Support: Julien_Rook

Publisher: Eternal Dream

Assets: Sources credited within the game

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any version of Windows
  • Processor: As long as the computer can boot up
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: As long as the screen can display something
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: As long as the speaker can produce sound
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows XP/Vista/7/8/8.1/10
  • Processor: Intel I3/I5/I7
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GT1030
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek

short_description: At first glance, your everyday life with your younger sister seems uneventful—going to school together, chatting, living side by side. But within that endless cycle of calm routines, could those seemingly insignificant actions be quietly changing your fate?
